title: Crestline Fleet Account Credit Status, Hold Release and Closure
content:
Credit status on a Crestline Fleet Account follows the payment record. An account moves between applied, active, credit hold, declined and closed.

## Clauses

- **Credit hold.** The account goes on credit hold when its days past due reach the program's credit hold days, or when the outstanding balance exceeds the credit limit by more than the program's over-limit tolerance percent. While on hold, stores stop charging to the account.
- **Release.** The hold is released when nothing is past due and the balance is within the limit; charging then resumes.
- **Collections.** A held account is closed and referred to collections when its days past due reach the program's collections referral days.
- **Closure by the business.** Closing an account is the business's own decision, confirmed by its authorized contact. The account must be in status active when the business's closure is completed; the status is the one shown on the account record at that point.
- **After closure.** No ticket is charged, the roster is closed, and the remaining balance stays due on the account's existing terms.

**Days past due** are the calendar days since the due date of the oldest invoice that still has an open amount above 0.00; they are 0 when nothing is past due.

## Thresholds on both sides (hypothetical account on a program with 30 credit hold days and 90 collections referral days)

| Oldest open invoice's days past due | Effect |
|---|---|
| 29 | not yet on credit hold for lateness |
| 30 | the hold threshold is reached: credit hold |
| 89 (on hold) | not yet referred |
| 90 (on hold) | closed and referred to collections |

## Over-limit test (hypothetical, limit 10000.00, tolerance 5 percent)

The tolerance is 500.00, so a balance of 10500.00 does not exceed the limit by more than the tolerance, while 10500.01 does and puts the account on credit hold.

## Closure by status

| Account status when the business's closure is completed | Closure by the business |
|---|---|
| active | completed |
| credit hold, applied, declined or closed | not completed under this clause |
